description: This file defines the RootPathContextService class, which provides functionality for managing and retrieving code snippets based on AST nodes and paths within a codebase. It interacts with an IDE, caches results, and uses tree-sitter queries to generate autocomplete snippets.

classes.name: RootPathContextService
classes.description: A service class that manages context-aware code snippets based on AST nodes and paths, utilizing caching and tree-sitter queries.

methods.name: getNodeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a syntax node based on its start index.

methods.name: keyFromNode
methods.description: Creates a cache key from a parent key and an AST node using SHA-256 hash.

methods.name: getSnippetsForNode
methods.description: Retrieves code snippets related to a specific AST node, executing tree-sitter queries.

methods.name: getSnippets
methods.description: Fetches code snippets from the IDE based on the end position of a node.

methods.name: getContextForPath
methods.description: Main method that retrieves context-aware code snippets for a given file path and AST path.
